reviews.text: It's quiet on weekdays because there are fewer people.

I had my credit card ready and asked if I would get AEON points, but they said, "If you pay with [credit card name], you will earn WAON points. Would you like to create a point card for our store?" Even though I swiped my credit card, they told me to press the checkout button when the screen changed. I was looking at the credit card terminal, so I think the explanation was insufficient. After that, the service was unfriendly.

Perhaps similar things have happened with semi-self-checkout machines, but it's the store's fault for setting it up that way, so I think they could have handled it a little better.
No accessories what so ever for large breeds like LABRADOR and GOLDENS. No harnesses or leashes, just clothes and snacks which are unhealthy. Disappointed as a Tourist with big hopes.
They have a wide variety of dog and cat food products, including brands I'd never heard of, and even frozen foods, making it feel like a department store!

This store has a great selection of products!

They allow pets, and I was so touched that a trainee employee I'd only met once remembered my pet's name!

It's a little far, but I prefer stores with employees like that.
Variety of products and always update with new items.
We spontaneously visited the PeTeMo shop and were amazed by the selection of cat toys. They have clothes and toys that you don't see or find in Europe. We even found something for our two cats! :)
Good place to buy cat food and snacks. Had tax free service for tourist as well.  Staffs are friendly and helpful.

I think this is a great pet supply store.
Not only does it have a great selection of products, both in quality and quantity, but the staff are knowledgeable enough to cover that. They are able to accurately answer even the most detailed and broad questions from an amateur, and will even guide you across the spacious store to find the product you're looking for.

I was a little disappointed that they didn't have the moist dog food I was looking for, called Best Balance for Seniors, but they had an incredible amount of dog and cat food and treats. I don't have a cat so I didn't look at the cat section, but I think there was probably a similar amount.
They also had some expensive organic dog food I'd never seen before, and even though I wasn't going to eat it myself, I was excited to try to buy it (lol).
They have a wide selection of pet supplies, and you can shop while walking your dog. There's even a pet-friendly elevator that goes up to the 3rd floor.
